meta.author: eta
meta.notes: v0.1 brass+crystal palette for Sprint 1; cohesive steampunk-dwarven scheme with warm metals, cool crystals, and legible UI neutrals

ui.notes: UI/HUD palette. panel.* are base and inverted HUD panel grounds; frame.* for decorative brass frames and rivets; accent.* for focus/interactive trims; text.* for legible copy; health/stamina bars with deep shadows; icon.slot.* for inventory grid slots; cursor.highlight for selection/hover ring.

terrain.notes: World terrain tints. rock.* for general mine strata; cave.* are environmental overlays for damp/cool and ember/warm moods.

materials.notes: Raw material color IDs used in inventory icons, crafting UI, and VFX sampling. metal.* are warm/dull; crystal.* are saturated jewel-tones.

effects.notes: FX accents. steam.* for particle fog layers; hit.flash for brief damage flashes; glow.* for emissive halos (crystal and warm lamps).

mapping.notes: Minimap legend. mapping.minimap.* read directly by the mapper; colors chosen for quick parsing over dark background.

telegraph.notes: Combat telegraph arcs. Amber = caution, Cyan = utility/ally, Green = safe path/charged.

lighting.notes: Screen-space lighting accents used across UI. ui_shadow multiplies behind panels; rim_brass for specular rim on brass frames.

accessibility.notes: Verify at 3x–4x scale in-engine; if ui.text.primary < 4.5:1 on ui.panel.bg, darken panel by ~3–5% or brighten primary by ~3% while maintaining warmth.

schema_hint.tokens: object of categories → token groups → hex strings; each category may include a 'notes' string for usage context
schema_hint.aliases: object of deprecated_id → current_id (empty in v0.1)

integration.loader: At startup, build ColorLUT from tokens.* by flattening nested keys into dot paths (e.g., 'ui.panel.bg'). For each leaf hex, register color without alpha; alpha is applied at render-time. Panic/log on missing token; apply fallback '#ff00ff' magenta for debugging and continue.
integration.notes: Minimap consumes mapping.minimap.* directly; combat events reference telegraph.arc.*; UI/HUD binds ui.* tokens by id. lighting.* used by shader constants for rim/specular and drop shadows.
